name: failover.fresh_row_landed
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body='fault-log-3'

name: failover.total_rows_after_two_replays
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body LIKE 'fault-log-%'

name: failover.replay_duplicates
probe: SELECT count() FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body='fault-log-0'

name: failover.replayed_workspace_distinct
probe: SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['lighthouse.workspace_id'] FROM lh018.otel_logs WHERE Body LIKE 'fault-log-%'
